summary: Replaces backup_isadoraair.sh's operator-memory-dependent BACKUP_REQUIRED_RECOVERY_COMPONENTS default (empty/unset) with one automatic, fail-closed recovery-component policy: kokoro/piper/fdkaac derived from the existing runtime-requirements authority (safe since r0029 closed the historical Kokoro-caller blind spot), protected_updater from an independent product/deployment rule never inferred from payload state. Explicit override remains available. No migration/dependency/service changes.
